Website Announcement Bar

A rotating, dismissible, schedulable announcement bar above your website header — built entirely on Odoo's native website-builder machinery.

Why this one?

No new models. No backend configuration screens. No theme assumptions. The bar is regular website content: you edit it inline with the standard website editor, and every control lives in the builder panel where you expect it.

Features

  • Native editing — text, links, fonts and colors via the standard editor toolbar.
  • Multiple messages — rotate automatically with configurable delay and slide/fade transition.
  • Visitor dismissal — optional close button; dismissal lasts for the browser-tab session.
  • Scheduling — optional Show From / Show Until datetimes.
  • Styling — bar font picker (Google Fonts supported) and theme-palette background colorpicker.
  • Multi-language & multi-website — native view translation and per-website copy-on-write.

Usage

  1. Install — the bar stays off by default, visitors never see placeholder content.
  2. Edit your website, click the header, switch Announcement Bar on.
  3. Click the bar to edit text and options. Save.
